stem: Which table correctly classifies statements about weather and climate?

options.label: A
options.text: Hail can form in thunderstorms that have strong winds. / The high temperature for Tuesday was 28 °C.

options.label: B
options.text: There will be thunderstorms tomorrow in the afternoon. / The month of February has had the coldest temperatures on record for thirty years.

options.label: C
options.text: August has the hottest temperatures each year. / A cold front is expected next week.

options.label: D
options.text: The high temperature for March is usually around 20 °C. / There are clear skies with no chance of rain for the next four days.

visual_elements: Table A: Weather - Hail can form in thunderstorms that have strong winds. Climate - The high temperature for Tuesday was 28 °C.
Table B: Weather - There will be thunderstorms tomorrow in the afternoon. Climate - The month of February has had the coldest temperatures on record for thirty years.
Table C: Weather - August has the hottest temperatures each year. Climate - A cold front is expected next week.
Table D: Weather - The high temperature for March is usually around 20 °C. Climate - There are clear skies with no chance of rain for the next four days.
